limitations: Compile-only proof; no actual receiver enumeration, input capture or PIO operation
Native USB host controller currently used for static dependency build; simultaneous Switch-device and PIO-host integration absent
Passive polling may return no input if receiver requires initialization; no guessed activation command will be sent
USB host enumeration normally includes standard control requests; no-commands claim concerns application vendor/motor/config commands
Single Pico USB-C connector cannot serve as both USB device and host simultaneously without a second controller/path
Direct Bluetooth input and fine haptics remain unverified; USB receiver component does not solve them
Static archive size includes SDK objects/debug data; not a linked firmware Flash or RAM footprint.
